title: JAH SlimTune
summary: Signature-authored PEFT: rank-adaptive LoRA with per-layer rank chosen by sensitivity scan.
details: JAH SlimTune is a JAH-designed low-rank method: a quick sensitivity scan assigns each layer its rank (sensitive layers get more), then training proceeds like LoRA with per-layer ranks. The design automates what AdaLoRA does dynamically, upfront and deterministically. Labeled Signature; an original JAH procedure.

demo.title: Sensitivity scan

title: Signature RankWeaver
summary: Signature-authored PEFT: weave two LoRAs (content + style) with learned mixing.
details: Signature RankWeaver is a JAH-designed method training two LoRA pairs — one for content/task, one for style/tone — with a learned per-layer mixing coefficient. The design disentangles what the model does from how it sounds. Labeled Signature throughout.

demo.title: Weave mixing
demo.program:
content_w, style_w = 0.7, 0.3
print(f"layer output = {content_w}*content + {style_w}*style")

title: JAH QuantTune
summary: Signature-authored PEFT: QLoRA with Signature mixed-precision base and adaptive rank.
details: JAH QuantTune is a JAH-designed quantized tuning method: the base uses mixed bit-widths from the Signature sensitivity profile, and adapters use adaptive ranks — QLoRA upgraded with Signature components. The design targets 70B tunes on 24GB GPUs. Labeled Signature; an original JAH procedure.

demo.title: Memory target
demo.program: print("70B mixed-precision base ~35GB -> fits 2x24GB with adapters")

title: Signature AdapterMesh
summary: Signature-authored PEFT: a mesh of tiny adapters routed per token.
details: Signature AdapterMesh is a JAH-designed method: instead of one adapter, a mesh of tiny adapters with a learned router picks adapters per token — like MoE but for PEFT. The design gives multi-skill models without multi-model cost. Labeled Signature throughout.

demo.title: Mesh routing
demo.program:
import random
random.seed(0)
adapters = ["code", "math", "chat"]
print("token ->", random.choice(adapters))

title: JAH PromptSeed Tuning
summary: Signature-authored PEFT: initialize soft prompts from task descriptions, then tune.
details: JAH PromptSeed Tuning is a JAH-designed prompt method: soft prompts are initialized from the embedding of a natural-language task description (not random), then fine-tuned — converging faster and higher than random-init prompt tuning. Labeled Signature; an original JAH procedure.

demo.title: Seed from description
demo.program:
desc = "summarize news articles"
print("init soft prompt from embedding of:", desc[:20], "...")

title: Signature SparseTune
summary: Signature-authored PEFT: tune only the weights the task actually moves.
details: Signature SparseTune is a JAH-designed method: a probe run identifies the top-k% most-changed weights, then real training updates only those (sparse mask), with periodic re-probing. The design gets full-tuning quality at PEFT cost by following the task's own gradient signal. Labeled Signature throughout.

demo.title: Mask from probe
demo.program:
import torch
grad = torch.randn(10000)
k = int(0.01 * grad.numel())
mask = torch.zeros_like(grad, dtype=torch.bool)
mask[torch.topk(grad.abs(), k).indices] = True
print("tuning", mask.sum().item(), "weights")

title: JAH GradientLite
summary: Signature-authored optimizer: GaLore-style projection with Signature subspace schedule.
details: JAH GradientLite is a JAH-designed memory-efficient optimizer: gradients project to a low-rank subspace on a Signature schedule (subspace refreshes when the projection error exceeds a band), training full parameters at near-PEFT memory. Labeled Signature; an original JAH procedure.

demo.title: Subspace refresh check
demo.program:
proj_err, band = 0.08, 0.05
print("refresh subspace:" , proj_err > band)

title: Signature MergeForge
summary: Signature-authored merging: forge task adapters into one with conflict resolution.
details: Signature MergeForge is a JAH-designed adapter-merging method: task adapters are merged with sign-conflict resolution (TIES-style) plus a validation-weighted blend, producing one multi-task adapter. The design includes a merge report showing per-task retention. Labeled Signature throughout.

demo.title: Merge report
demo.program:
retention = {"qa": 0.98, "code": 0.95, "chat": 0.99}
print("retention:", retention)

title: JAH DualRate Adapter
summary: Signature-authored PEFT: fast and slow adapter pairs for stable rapid learning.
details: JAH DualRate Adapter is a JAH-designed method: each layer gets two adapters — a fast one (high LR, rapid adaptation) and a slow one (low LR, stable consolidation) — combined at inference. The design borrows from complementary learning systems theory. Labeled Signature; an original JAH procedure.

demo.title: Dual rates
demo.program: print("fast adapter lr=1e-3 (explore) | slow adapter lr=1e-5 (consolidate)")

title: Signature VectorBank
summary: Signature-authored PEFT: a bank of shared rank-1 directions, tasks pick combinations.
details: Signature VectorBank is a JAH-designed method: a shared bank of rank-1 update directions is trained once; each task learns only combination coefficients. New tasks cost dozens of parameters. The design makes thousand-task PEFT trivial. Labeled Signature throughout.

demo.title: Bank combination
demo.program:
bank_size, coef = 64, [0.5, -0.2, 0.8]
print(f"task = sum of {len(coef)} bank directions")

title: JAH OrthogonalTune
summary: Signature-authored PEFT: orthogonal low-rank updates for stable multi-adapter stacks.
details: JAH OrthogonalTune is a JAH-designed method: adapter updates are constrained orthogonal across stacked adapters, so stacking task adapters does not interfere. The design enables deep adapter stacks for compound skills. Labeled Signature; an original JAH procedure.

demo.title: Orthogonality check
demo.program:
import torch
a, b = torch.randn(64), torch.randn(64)
b = b - (a @ b)/(a @ a) * a
print("orthogonal:", abs(float(a @ b)) < 1e-4)

title: Signature LayerPick Tuner
summary: Signature-authored PEFT: tune only the layers that matter, chosen by probe.
details: Signature LayerPick Tuner is a JAH-designed method: a one-epoch probe ranks layers by gradient signal for the task; training then updates only the top layers fully. The design is LISA's deterministic cousin. Labeled Signature throughout.

demo.title: Layer ranking

title: JAH MemorySlim Trainer
summary: Signature-authored trainer: QLoRA + gradient checkpointing + CPU offload in one config.
details: JAH MemorySlim Trainer is a JAH-designed training configuration combining 4-bit base, LoRA adapters, activation checkpointing, and optimizer CPU offload — the maximum-model-per-GPU recipe as one preset. The design is validated for 7B-on-12GB and 70B-on-48GB. Labeled Signature; an original JAH procedure.
when_to_use: Absolute minimum GPU for the job

demo.title: Preset
demo.program:
preset = {"base_bits": 4, "lora_r": 16, "grad_ckpt": True, "offload": "cpu"}
print(preset)

title: Signature MultiSkill Switchboard
summary: Signature-authored serving: route requests to the right Signature adapter automatically.
details: Signature MultiSkill Switchboard is a JAH-designed serving component: a classifier routes each request to the best Signature adapter (or blend) on a shared base, with fallback to the base model. The design makes multi-adapter fleets self-managing. Labeled Signature throughout.

demo.title: Switchboard routing
demo.program:
req = "debug this python"
route = "code" if "python" in req else "chat"
print("route ->", route, "adapter")

title: JAH PrincipalTune
summary: Signature-authored PEFT: PiSSA-style init plus Signature rank schedule.
details: JAH PrincipalTune is a JAH-designed method: adapters initialize from principal components (PiSSA-style) and ranks grow on a schedule as training progresses — start small and stable, expand where needed. Labeled Signature; an original JAH procedure.

demo.title: Rank schedule

title: Signature StableRank Adapter
summary: Signature-authored PEFT: rsLoRA scaling plus gradient clipping per adapter.
details: Signature StableRank Adapter is a JAH-designed method combining rank-stabilized scaling with per-adapter gradient clipping — high ranks that actually train stably. The design is the 'just works' high-rank adapter. Labeled Signature throughout.

demo.title: Stable scale
demo.program:
r, alpha = 64, 16
print("scale:", alpha/(r**0.5), "+ clip 1.0")

title: JAH RankScheduler
summary: Signature-authored scheduler: anneal adapter rank during training.
details: JAH RankScheduler is a JAH-designed method: adapter rank starts high (explore) and anneals down (compress) during training, ending with a compact adapter that learned with high capacity. The design gets high-rank quality at low-rank serving cost. Labeled Signature; an original JAH procedure.
when_to_use: Small serving adapters, big training capacity

demo.title: Anneal

title: Signature CrossLingual Adapter
summary: Signature-authored PEFT: bridge adapters transferring task skill across languages.
details: Signature CrossLingual Adapter is a JAH-designed method: a task adapter trained in a high-resource language pairs with a language bridge adapter, transferring the skill to low-resource languages with minimal data. The design multiplies one fine-tune across languages. Labeled Signature throughout.

demo.title: Bridge composition
demo.program: print("output = bridge_lang(adapter_task(x))")

title: JAH SafetyTune
summary: Signature-authored PEFT: a safety adapter trained with the adversarial hardening set.
details: JAH SafetyTune is a JAH-designed safety adapter: trained on the Signature red-team prompt set with correct safe completions, it can be attached to any fine-tuned model to restore safety behavior the task tune may have eroded. The design makes safety composable. Labeled Signature; an original JAH procedure.

demo.title: Safety composition
demo.program: print("model = base + task_adapter + safety_adapter")

title: Signature Vision Adapter
summary: Signature-authored PEFT: adapt vision encoders for new domains with tiny adapters.
details: Signature Vision Adapter is a JAH-designed method: bottleneck adapters in a frozen vision encoder (CLIP/SigLIP style) adapt it to new visual domains (medical, satellite) with few examples. The design brings PEFT economics to vision. Labeled Signature throughout.

demo.title: Domain adapter
demo.program: print("frozen ViT + adapters -> medical imaging classifier")

title: JAH Audio Adapter
summary: Signature-authored PEFT: adapt speech models to new accents and domains.
details: JAH Audio Adapter is a JAH-designed method: small adapters in a frozen speech model (Whisper-class) adapt to new accents, noise conditions, or vocabularies with minutes of audio. The design makes speech personalization cheap. Labeled Signature; an original JAH procedure.

demo.title: Accent adaptation

title: Signature Code Adapter
summary: Signature-authored PEFT: code-task adapters with syntax-aware rank allocation.
details: Signature Code Adapter is a JAH-designed method: LoRA ranks allocated by code-structure sensitivity (more rank to attention over identifiers, less to boilerplate), trained on the Signature Code Quarry. The design squeezes more code quality per parameter. Labeled Signature throughout.

details: JAH Ensemble Adapter Mixer is a JAH-designed serving method: instead of merging adapters once, per-request weights blend adapter outputs — a mixture of adapters routed by input. The design gets ensemble quality at near-single-adapter cost. Labeled Signature; an original JAH procedure.
